messages:
sophie: Noticing weird regional split on /v1/respond latency: global p99 jumped from ~210ms -> ~740ms but US-only view is flat. EU region shows a big tail around 02:10 UTC. anyone else seeing region attribution confusion? :globe_with_meridians:
ed: paste of a few samples below + console link: https://console.redwood/latency?endpoint=/v1/respond&range=2h&split=region
---
# samples (ts, region, route, latency_ms)
2026-04-12T02:09:58Z region=eu route=low-cost-eu latency_ms=720
2026-04-12T02:10:05Z region=eu route=low-cost-eu latency_ms=750
2026-04-12T02:10:12Z region=us route=primary latency_ms=215
2026-04-12T02:10:30Z region=eu route=low-cost-eu latency_ms=690
---
mike: looks like cheap-eu variant spiked and it's pulling the blended global p99 up. the console global chart shows p50/p95/p99 but not per-region counts; that makes triage annoying.
tara: UX suggestion: add per-region rows under the percentile legend with p50/p95/p99 and sample_count (n=...). allow collapsing by route within region. also show a small "region-contributor" badge on the global p99 if >25% of the tail comes from a single region that differs from the viewer's default region.
sophie: agree. also: we should support an API param to the timeseries endpoint: `region_split=true|false` and `attribution_mode=blended|initial|final`. default keep backwards compat = blended. will need to document region behavior for SLOs.
ed: telemetry note: right now we tag samples with region and route, but the frontend only requests global aggregates. computing per-region pcts on-demand is expensive. proposing ingestion-side rollups per endpoint+region+route at 1m granularity (p50/p95/p99 + count) to make UI cheap. storage delta estimate pending.
mike: short-term hack: show top-3 contributing regions in the hovercard for p99 with their p99s and counts. show a yellow "small-n" triangle when region_n < 50. also show a confidence line: bootstrap CI or "estimate noisy" when n<30.
tara: SLO UX: add a small toggle in SLO config: attribute SLO to viewer_region or global_final. default to viewer_region for product owners. ops can flip. this avoids surprises when ops route traffic internationally.
metrics-bot: ticket T-9021 created: "per-region percentile rollups + region-contributor badge + timeseries API params" by ed. linked: infra/telemetry cost estimate.
sophie: action items: ed -> rollup cost estimate and quick backfill; mike -> hovercard mock + small-n treatment; tara -> SLO toggle copy and config UX; I'll draft the API param doc and changelog note.
ed: I'll run a quick sample backfill to gauge storage and post numbers by EOD.
sophie: thanks. let's prioritize the hovercard + badge as quick wins to reduce pager noise. marking thread resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
